title: Performance Models: Speedup, Scaling Laws and the Roofline

contract.reader: An engineer or student who writes numerical code and wants to know, before and after parallelizing, how fast it can become
contract.problem: Predicting and honestly reporting the speedup of a parallel program, and finding which resource bounds it
contract.outcome: Compute Amdahl, Gustafson and overhead bounds and the Karp-Flatt fraction; bound run time by work and span; place a kernel on a measured roofline; time a kernel honestly
contract.contribution: Every model evaluated with numbers from one reference machine (measured peak, bandwidth and ridge point) and closed by a reporting checklist that later entries follow
contract.evidence: Derivations; programs with their output; Amdahl, Gustafson, Karp and Flatt, Brent, Graham, Williams et al., McCalpin, Hoefler and Belli, Hennessy and Patterson
contract.limitations: One shared virtual machine; memory hierarchy and networks deferred to entries 2 and 5
